scenario: coref — 文本用编号 1a/2a 替换原料与产物，必须靠图像 dict_result 做 ID→SMILES 映射
procedure_text: To a solution of oxalyl chloride (1.2 eq) in CH2Cl2 at -78 °C under argon is added dropwise DMSO (2.4 eq) in CH2Cl2. After stirring for 1 hour at -78 °C, a solution of 1a (1.0 eq) in CH2Cl2 is added dropwise. After stirring for 2 hours at -78 °C, triethylamine (5.0 eq) is added dropwise, and the mixture is stirred at -78 °C for 1 hour, then warmed to 25 °C and stirred overnight. The reaction is partitioned between CH2Cl2 and 1 N HCl, and the organic layer is washed with water, dried over MgSO4, and concentrated in vacuo to afford 2a (95%) as a yellow oil.
note: Swern oxidation, 原料/产物用编号 1a/2a。校验：coref 应 resolved=2, id_smiles_mapping={1a: OCCCCCc1ccccc1, 2a: O=CCCCCc1ccccc1}，与图像 dict_result 对齐。
